items.title: Approve the Minutes of the January 23, 2024 Meeting
Appoint Kat Siegal and Venecia Margarita as the District 5 and District 9 Representatives, Respectively, to the Community Advisory Committee
Approve the 2024 State and Federal Legislative Program
Adopt Four 2023 Prop L 5-Year Prioritization Programs and Amend the Prop L Strategic Plan Baseline
Allocate $10,489,620 in Prop L Funds, with Conditions, to the San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency for Paratransit
Release $130,000 in Previously Allocated Prop L Funds to the San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency for Vision Zero Education and Communications: Speed Safety
Adopt a Motion of Support to Adopt Fiscal Year 2024/25 Transportation Fund for Clean Air Local Expenditure Criteria
Final Approval - Adopt Five Job Classifications and Revised Organization Chart
CLOSED SESSION - Final Approval - Evaluate Public Employee Performance and Approve the Executive Director’s Performance Objectives for 2024
Final Approval - Set the Annual Compensation for the Executive Director for 2024
